items:
Welcome to Saltlight Hideaway, a luxurious retreat in the gated community of The Hammocks, Seagrove Beach. Steps from 30A's stunning beaches, this light-filled home features an open-concept living area, designer decor, and room for up to 8 guests. Enjoy large windows, outdoor spaces, and easy access to Seaside, WaterColor, and local shops and dining. The Hammocks offers two pools and a peaceful, private setting. Parking for 3 cars. No pets allowed. Book your stay and experience 30A’s charm!

Step inside and feel instantly at home in this professionally designed space. The open-concept living, kitchen, and dining areas are perfect for gathering with family and friends. Relax in the spacious living room with ample seating and a 70” TV for movie nights or watching your favorite sports. The home is beautifully accented with shiplap and unique architectural features, while large windows flood the interior with natural light, bringing the beauty of the surroundings indoors.

Saltlight Hideaway exudes luxury and tranquility. The designer touches, cool color palette, and comfortable furnishings create the ideal environment for relaxation. With plenty of space for up to 8 guests, inviting outdoor areas, and easy access to all that 30A has to offer, this home is the perfect destination for your next beach vacation.

Beach essentials included:
✔ 8 chairs ✔ 1 umbrella ✔ 8 towels ✔ Backpack cooler

Sleeping Arrangements:
• 1st Floor, Bedroom 1: Twin-over-twin bunk bed, TV.
• 2nd Floor, Bedroom 2: Queen bed, TV. Shared hallway bathroom with shower.
• 2nd Floor, Bedroom 3: King bed, TV. Private bathroom with vanity and shower.
• 2nd Floor, Bedroom 4: King bed, TV. Private bathroom with dual sinks, soaking tub, large shower, and spacious closets.

Other details”
Custom inset cabinetry, Thermador/Kitchenaid Appliance package, all marble counters, Restoration Hardware/Aiden Gray lighting, Restoration Hardware faucets, Jeldwen Aluminum Clad window package

The Hammocks:
This private, gated community is just an 8-minute walk or a 3-minute bike ride from the beach access at the end of 395. Surrounded by trees and protected wetlands, The Hammocks offers a peaceful, secluded atmosphere while still being close to the vibrant energy of 30A. Choose between two neighborhood pools for a relaxing swim when you’re not soaking up the sun at the beach!

Seagrove Beach:
Located in the heart of 30A, Seagrove Beach is known for its iconic oak trees and pristine shoreline. This prime location gives you access to everything the area has to offer. Rent a bike and explore the 20-mile Timpoochee Trail, visit the famous Seaside community, or discover nearby gems like Grayton Beach State Park, Alys Beach, and Rosemary Beach. Whether you’re browsing boutique shops, dining at local restaurants, or exploring state parks, there’s something for everyone to enjoy.

Beach Access:
Just a short 8-minute walk or 2-minute bike ride to the largest public beach on 30A! The beach access is uncrowded due to limited parking, and most beachgoers are from nearby homes within walking distance, ensuring a more peaceful experience.
Scenic 395 Beach Access:
2780 E County Hwy 30A
Santa Rosa Beach, FL 32459

Additional Information:

• No pets allowed.
• Parking for up to 3 cars.

Guests will receive amenities, including paper towels, dish soap, shampoo, conditioner, body wash, towels, and dish and laundry pods to make your stay as comfortable as possible.

Book your stay at Saltlight Hideaway today and experience the best of 30A in style!
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.
